title: Fix Illegal Direct Store Flow
scenario: In a valid Data Flow Diagram, an External Entity can never read or write directly to a Data Store without passing through a Process. Fix this broken payroll DFD!
goal: Remove the illegal Employee -> D1 Timesheets edge and route data properly through "2.0 Record Hours".
learningObjective: Enforce the DFD rule that all data transformations and store writes must pass through a Process.
hints: Delete the direct edge between Employee and D1 Timesheets.
Connect Employee -> 2.0 Record Hours, and 2.0 Record Hours -> D1 Timesheets.
solutionExplanation: External Entities cannot access Data Stores directly. Routing Employee -> 2.0 Record Hours -> D1 Timesheets satisfies DFD syntax rules.
